description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between S. A. Ariyasena, Colombo 08, and other part Janashakthi Insurance PLC. Colombo 02 (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It involves the statutory publication of a legal decision made through arbitration proceedings established by legislation, specifically referencing the Industrial Disputes Act and its amendments. The content focuses on the legal resolution of an industrial dispute between private parties (an individual and a company), not government personnel changes or structural modifications.
